citation: Wiggins, M., Jerrim, J., Tripney, J., Khatwa, M., & Gough, D. (2019). The RISE project: Evidence-informed school improvement. Evaluation report and executive summary. London: Education Endowment Foundation.
report_number: EEF project: The RISE Project (Research leads Improving Students' Education); evaluation by UCL Institute of Education, May 2019
design: 2-arm cluster RCT; unit of randomisation = School; 40 secondary schools recruited (20 intervention / 20 control), 1 control school withdrew so analysis = 39 schools (20 intervention + 19 control); business-as-usual control; efficacy trial led by developer (Huntington School, York). Dual primary outcomes = GCSE mathematics and GCSE English point scores (NPD KS4 EBacc pillar scores), measured separately for two distinct pupil cohorts: Cohort A (took GCSEs 2015/16, exposed to 1 year of intervention) and Cohort B (took GCSEs 2016/17, exposed to 2 years of intervention). Years 10-11 (England Key Stage 4, ages 15-16; grade band 7-12 per registry). Pre-test = Key Stage 2 SATs scores.
problems: The report reports Cohen's d, not Hedges' g; with N>6000 the small-sample J correction is ~0.9999 so g is numerically identical to the reported d to 4 dp (J applied). Effect sizes = regression-adjusted (OLS, controlling for KS2 prior attainment, with strata and Huber-White cluster-robust SEs) difference in means standardised by the TOTAL/pooled SD of the raw outcome (EEF convention), confirmed by adj_diff/sqrt(pooled_variance) reproducing reported d (e.g. Cohort A maths 0.157/sqrt(3.176)=0.088->0.09). Impact SE not printed for the main OLS model; derived from the reported 95% CIs as SE = (upper-lower)/(2*1.96). These CIs are cluster/design-adjusted (the svy/Huber-White model already accounts for clustering), so cluster_adjusted=true and the CI-derived SE is the cluster-adjusted SE. Cohort B English CI (-0.11, 0.18) is asymmetric about d=0.03, so its CI-derived SE (0.074) is approximate. Table 16 robustness ordered-logit SEs are similar but for a different model and not used. The study has TWO distinct cohorts (different pupils, different intervention dose: 1 vs 2 years), not repeated waves of the same pupils; both are end-of-treatment GCSE measurements for their respective doses. All 4 full-sample (2 cohort x 2 subject) primary contrasts are extracted and labelled by cohort so central merge can select; the 2-year cohort (Cohort B) is the full-dose end-of-treatment arm and the 1-year cohort (Cohort A) is the lower-dose arm. ICCs recorded are the realised analysis-stage school-level design ICCs per outcome (Tables 5-8). Cohort B English security downgraded by EEF (moderate-to-high) due to lower power. FSM-eligible subgroup results (Tables 17-18) extracted as subgroup records (is_full_sample=false). The planned secondary outcome (teachers' research use, NFER tool) was not analysable due to low response and is not a student achievement outcome, so not extracted. Cohort B English Table 15 prints an 'adjusted difference in means' of 0.699 which is internally inconsistent with the reported d=0.03 (would imply d~0.35); treated as a typo and the report's headline d=0.03 from Table 14 used.

effect_sizes.arm_label: RISE (single TPD arm) vs business-as-usual control — Cohort A (1 year of intervention, GCSEs 2015/16)
effect_sizes.test_name: GCSE Mathematics point score (NPD KS4_EBPTSMAT_PTQ_EE / EBacc maths pillar)
effect_sizes.timepoint: post (GCSE exams May/June 2016, end of 1-year intervention dose)
effect_sizes.g_method: Report's Cohen's d = adjusted (OLS, KS2-controlled, strata + Huber-White cluster-robust) difference in means / sqrt(pooled total variance of outcome) = 0.157/sqrt(3.176). J small-sample correction applied (J=0.99989, df=6812) -> g=J*d=0.09. SE from reported 95% CI (-0.03, 0.20): SE=(0.20-(-0.03))/(2*1.96)=0.0587; g_se=J*SE; g_var=g_se^2. CI/SE already cluster-adjusted.

effect_sizes.notes: Maths -> STEM. Dual primary outcome. p=0.15. n in model 6814 (3328 int; 3486 ctrl). 39 schools analysed (20 int + 19 ctrl). Raw posttest means from Table 12 (CIs in report); raw SDs per arm not tabulated for outcome (only pooled variance reported).
